questions.question: It was the city that had been hit by the earthquake, not the surrounding countryside.
options: The city was the one that had been affected.
It was the city which had been damaged.
The city is the place that got destroyed.
The city was the area most severely affected.
questions.answer: It was the city which had been damaged.

questions.question: Unless I'd studied harder, I wouldn't have passed the exam.
options: If I hadn't studied so hard, I would not have passed.
I would not have passed unless I had studied more.
Had I studied less, I wouldn't be here now.
I would not have passed if I hadn't studied.
questions.answer: Unless I'd studied harder, I wouldn't have passed the exam.

questions.question: The teacher asked her students to refrain from making too much noise.
options: The teacher told his students to be quiet.
She advised them to keep their voices down.
It was suggested that they speak more softly.
He ordered the class to remain silent.
questions.answer: The teacher asked her students to refrain from making too much noise.

questions.question: I'd rather you didn't tell anyone about this.
options: It would be better if you kept it a secret.
Please don't mention this to anyone else.
You should keep this confidential.
Don't say anything to anyone, please.
questions.answer: I'd rather you didn't tell anyone about this.

questions.question: The new policy will only come into effect if the government approves it.
options: Unless the government approves it, the new policy won't be implemented.
If the government doesn't approve it, then the policy will still go ahead.
Only when the government has given its approval will the new policy start.
The new policy will never come into effect unless the government agrees.
questions.answer: Unless the government approves it, the new policy won't be implemented.
